title: Daily Market Digest: September 18, 2026
subtitle: Wall Street Drifts Lower Amid Yield Concerns and Triple Witching

items.headline: U.S. Stocks Edge Lower as Treasury Yields Rise and "Triple Witching" Adds Volatility
items.summary: U.S. equities are largely down today, concluding a volatile week marked by rising Treasury yields and fluctuating oil prices. Investors are continuing to digest the Federal Reserve's recent interest rate hike, which occurred earlier this week. The quarterly expiration of derivatives contracts, known as "triple witching," is contributing to heightened market activity and potential swings. Ten of the eleven major S&P 500 sectors are reporting losses, with basic materials and industrials among the bottom performers.

items.headline: Xenon Pharmaceuticals Plummets on Trial Pause
items.summary: Xenon Pharmaceuticals ($XENE) tumbled over 27% today after temporarily halting enrollment in trials for its experimental drug, following reports of side effects.

items.headline: Netflix Shares Slide Following Downgrade
items.summary: Shares of Netflix ($NFLX) fell today after the streaming giant received a downgrade from analysts.

items.headline: Nucor Falls on Disappointing Q3 Profit Outlook
items.summary: Steel maker Nucor ($NUE) sank 5.9% after forecasting third-quarter profit that fell short of analysts' expectations, despite higher prices, due to absorbing higher costs.

items.headline: Broadcom Posts Modest Gains
items.summary: Broadcom ($AVGO) saw a slight increase today, contributing positively to broader indices.

items.headline: Markets Continue to Process Federal Reserve Rate Hike
items.summary: Investors are still grappling with the implications of the Federal Reserve's first interest rate hike in three years, announced earlier this week. Commentary from Fed Chair Kevin Warsh on the future trajectory of borrowing costs is keeping market participants engaged.

items.headline: 10-Year Treasury Yield Tops 5% Amid Rising Pressure
items.summary: The yield on the benchmark 10-year Treasury note climbed to 5.00% today, reaching a level not seen since 2023. This increase in bond yields is contributing to downward pressure on the stock market.

items.headline: Crude Oil Prices Volatile Amid Middle East Tensions
items.summary: Crude oil prices exhibited volatility today, with Brent crude slipping 0.5% to $104.31 a barrel. Markets are weighing supply concerns following fresh strikes between Saudi Arabia and Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis.

items.headline: Goldman Sachs: S&P 500 'Over-Earning' is Temporary, Not a Bubble
items.summary: Goldman Sachs analysts suggest that the S&P 500's 'over-earning' phenomenon, driven by the AI investment boom and expanded semiconductor margins, is a temporary acceleration rather than an 'earnings bubble.' They anticipate earnings growth to decelerate in the coming years, but not collapse.

items.headline: Warren Buffett Steps Down as Berkshire Hathaway Chairman
items.summary: Investing legend Warren Buffett has stepped down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway ($BRK.A, $BRK.B) and will become chairman emeritus, effective immediately. His son, Howard Buffett, will assume the chairman role.
